description: This file handles the saving of configuration settings in an Administration module within a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It performs access control, processes POST data to update configuration categories, and redirects after saving.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating Bean instances.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves configuration settings based on POST data, handling specific cases like license expiration date and license key, then redirects.
